triggers.description: Bare Actuating reconciles implementation, publication, review, and closure.
Explicit bounded routes select implement, triage, remediation-plan, or review-closeout.
A current or historically witnessed falsifier may expose a semantic hotspot or architecture defect.
exclusions: isolated syntax or mechanical mistake wholly inside an already-correct owner
environment failure with no semantic boundary implication

triggers.description: Current evidence falsifies or extends the incumbent architecture.
exclusions: diff size or implementation rewrite alone
one local defect whose predicate-defined family is already excluded by the incumbent

triggers.description: Unqualified review, inspect, audit, or classify intent is non-mutating triage.

routes.description: Reconcile and realize the current target locally.
Acquire and classify current owner evidence without mutation.
Resolve current review pressure, publish when required, and converge.
Hand exact Git and validation facts to Ship.

required_artifacts: accepted Goal
exact Git base/head/tree
owner-issued validation, review, and publication evidence when applicable
success_signals: Git is the realized construction
CAS owns review attempts
Ship owns public effects
Actuating keeps no durable workflow store
failure_signals: Actuating copies owner facts into an event log
a stored Actuating verdict outranks current owner state
Ledger grants mutation, review credit, or closure
clauses.rationale: Reconciliation remains current when durable facts stay with their owners and interpretations are recomputed.

required_artifacts: exact witness subject and current applicability subject
named violated law and law provenance
detection surface distinct from candidate admission frontier or cut
current Review Fold observational class when multiple witnesses are claimed
family predicate or generator, domain, sanctioned admission relation, and claim strength
current owner set and owner status
bounded classified repository-native semantic scar tissue when applicable
counterexample topology and correctness delta when architecture reopens
success_signals: a bug is treated as a witness rather than a patch instruction or complete family
historical witness provenance remains distinct from current applicability
distributed ownership may form one same-law observational class
Actuating partitions classes by frontier and selects a minimal admission cut when needed
one universal-law falsifier over a sanctioned path may reopen architecture immediately
the selected target states disposition, invalid region eliminated, admission coverage, escape paths retired, derived guards preserved, and residual invalidity
failure_signals: observed examples are treated as the complete family
historical witness provenance is rewritten as current-head provenance
one current owner is required when owner dilution may be the defect
one frontier is invented when path coverage requires an admission cut
file proximity, churn, or an arbitrary bug count establishes a hotspot
containment or another compensating guard is called correct by construction
a hotspot registry, score, threshold, receipt, or durable store is created
clauses.rationale: Bugs improve architecture only when a predicate-defined invalid family is traced across sanctioned paths to sufficient semantic authority and excluded at an honest claim strength.

required_artifacts: incumbent model reconstructed from the current tree
architecture-closure judgment
Architecture Working Set when selection reopens
correctness-relation evidence for bug-driven candidates
correctness Pareto frontier before cost minimization
success_signals: local repair preserves an incumbent already closed under the predicate-defined family
semantic novelty, sanctioned universal-law falsification, distributed ownership, or a semantic hotspot reopens selection before mutation
correctness-equivalent candidates are minimized only after the Pareto frontier is established
material correctness/cost tradeoffs remain incomparable
First Principles, Universalist, bounded Metanoetic challenge, and Reduce retain their authority boundaries
failure_signals: new semantics hide inside a realization repair
candidate comparison ignores family domain, admission coverage, escape paths, owner dilution, guard roles, or residual proof burden
unsupported prose claims set inclusion or family elimination

clauses.rationale: Architecture selection minimizes admitted incorrectness at an explicit evidence strength while preserving every required valid observation and compatibility obligation.

required_artifacts: static actuating-review-contract/v2
exact CAS receipts for the current Git head
current Review Fold after findings
success_signals: initial standard plus four compact auxiliaries launch concurrently
five consecutive standard cleans bind the exact unchanged head
material head change invalidates credit by identity
missing resumable evidence restarts a fresh wave
failure_signals: review count reconstructed from prose
full standalone auxiliary workflows recursively launch inside the wave
review evidence copied into an Actuating store
clauses.rationale: CAS-owned receipts provide durable attempt facts; Actuating derives credit without duplicating them.

required_artifacts: current Goal
current exact Git head
current validation
current Ship evidence when required
current CAS evidence when required
witness rejection and family-exclusion proof when bug-driven
explicit eliminated, contained, obstructed, or unresolved disposition
success_signals: closure is reevaluated from live owner facts
accepted current witnesses are rejected through sanctioned paths
eliminated families carry domain, admission, coverage, and claim-strength proof

instrumentation.rationale: The current Git tree and owner-issued evidence are the facts; Actuating reports its live judgment without persisting a peer authority artifact or hotspot registry.
